improvements: Clarify generic media finding as recognized container header rather than implying complete validity.
Consolidate duplicate GIF magic into offset-zero baseline identity; cover actual gif file type and retain former source/media exclusion consumers.
Validate PHP long-tag boundary and support case variants and short-echo tags.

Use bounded PHP parsing in filefacts to bind HTTP-input subscripts to the first argument of actual global function calls; exclude quoted/commented examples, methods, static methods, later argument positions and ambiguous namespaced calls.

Replace PHP media command/eval regexes with parsed value facts; add COOKIE/FILES sources, pipe-process calls and uppercase function handling; require actual eval rather than version-dependent assert semantics.
Remove the generic PHP command webshell conviction based only on unrelated request and command-call co-occurrence.
Mark GIF comment, application and plain-text extension payloads as freeform regions for the existing executable/archive header inspection, leaving compressed frame data alone.
Clarify media payload-header and PHP syntax descriptions; correct inverse GIF/PHP extension-mismatch naming.

validator_exceptions.reason: The same parsed relationship is emitted for all passive carriers, including BMP; retain the original carrier family without duplicate rules.
Exact byte-zero magic has the same meaning under GIF or source/script typing; extracted text did not preserve the header on all samples.
A PHP delimiter followed by newline can be too short for media string extraction; inspect original bytes. Parsed call facts still bind the execution verdict.

corrections_from_integration_tests: Use byte-zero hex matching rather than extracted-text offsets: original 100 GIFs initially had only 98 header findings.
Use a deterministic parser work budget and a wall backstop rather than a 50ms wall-clock deadline: parallel analysis exposed missed relationships.
Treat PHP opening tags as byte markers in extracted strings; a newline after the tag can be removed by string extraction, while parsed call facts enforce a valid tag.
Slice the binary media at its first valid PHP tag before parsing. A GIF comment length byte could otherwise act as a PHP comment delimiter and erase a real request-to-command call.
